title: spec: navigation.size describe says auto derives the drawer size from field count and viewport, which the renderer no longer does
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36149 (PR #36438). L1-d found it out of scope. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the TSDoc around line 3033 and the describe at line 3038) says the default `navigation.size: 'auto'` makes the renderer derive the drawer size from the object's field count and the viewport, so "AI writes nothing". The renderer has not done that since #27545. An author or an agent reading the describe text is told about a behaviour that does not exist.

## To do

1. Measure what `'auto'` resolves to on main, for the record drawer and the other record overlays.
2. Rewrite the TSDoc and the describe text to say exactly that, and regenerate the references.

## Acceptance

- The `navigation.size` TSDoc and describe text match what the renderer does for `'auto'`, and the generated references agree.

The diff edits a published spec file (prose only), so its review is at the contract tier.

## Grade
p3 · domain:spec. A describe sentence that no longer holds.
